product_risk_or_requirement: Factual hallucination prevention in financial and technical advice
current_state: Raw LLM generates text without verified source grounding leading to factual and arithmetic errors
product_requirement: System must verify numerical and technical claims against authoritative knowledge bases and require editor confirmation
acceptance_criteria: Given a user requests marketing copy containing numerical claims When the draft is generated Then the system must highlight unverified figures with citation badges and require editor confirmation before export
evidence_needed: Automated grounding benchmark test suite report achieving 98 percent accuracy on technical formulas

product_risk_or_requirement: Copyright infringement and unauthorized verbatim regurgitation
current_state: Generative model outputs can duplicate proprietary copyrighted articles without attribution
product_requirement: System must execute automated similarity scanning against indexed publications and flag overlapping text
acceptance_criteria: Given an AI generated draft with over 15 percent lexical similarity to copyrighted articles When export is requested Then the system must block automated export and present side-by-side attribution options to the creator
evidence_needed: Pre-launch copyright scan benchmark showing zero undetected verbatim passages over 50 words
